Follows Claude Code 2.1.314: folded tool calls that a permission rule or a PreToolUse hook blocked now read as not run instead of failed.

- A folded line like `Ran 3 commands (2 failed)` counted blocked calls as commands that ran and failed. It now reads `Ran a command · 2 not run`, the way Claude Code 2.1.314's own folded group does, and `2 actions not run` when nothing in it ran
- Expanded, a blocked call's row ends in a dim `not run` instead of a red `failed`
- The dim `3 commands (1 failed)` line under a long turn no longer counts blocked commands
- Calls auto mode's classifier blocked, or that you rejected in the permission dialog, still read as failed: a plugin can't tell them apart from a command that failed

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
